# paszed.me

Official website of Edvard Pasz, a software engineer focused on developer tools, AI applications, software architecture, and modern web engineering.

This website serves as a personal engineering journal, project portfolio, and long-term knowledge base documenting software projects, technical writing, and ongoing learning.

## Purpose

The goal of this website is to document real engineering work, publish technical writing, share open-source projects, and continuously improve engineering practices through public documentation.
